recipes.title: Qwen3.8 27B (NVFP4) for coding agents
recipes.source: Model and parser choices from Mia's AI Lab (github.com/MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-27B-SGLang-DGX-Spark), served here on upstream vLLM with its built-in MTP head
recipes.description: Dense 27B vision-language model, NVFP4 with a BF16 head, MTP speculative decoding, 256K context, tool calling. Checked on the Jetson AGX Thor 2026-09-27: 17-28 tok/s, needle recall to 170K tokens.
